Chess Openings Import: [Chess #5]

Released Nov 10, 2025, 45 min

Play Chess Openings Import: [Chess #5] on YouTube
Watch on YouTube

In this video, I show how I use sparql-anything to ETL structured data into the ontology. I take a dataset from Kaggle and generate a sparql query to expand our chess ontology. This episode is mostly query construction, but it touches on how we have to make some ontology design decisions as part of ETL processes.
